params.description: Streaming codec frames per event; grow starts at one and increases to this cap. Each frame is 40 ms of audio.
params.name: stream_frames_per_event

params.description: Streaming chunk schedule. The non-causal codec always retains ten frames of left and right context.
params.name: stream_chunk_policy

params.description: Maximum generated AR tokens; zero uses the default. Must not exceed the configured context length.
params.name: max_tokens

params.description: Return generated audio with a warning instead of failing when max_tokens is reached before EOC. Audio may be truncated or contain silence/noise.
params.name: allow_incomplete_generation

params.description: AR sampling temperature. Must be positive.
params.name: temperature

params.description: AR nucleus sampling probability. Must be positive.
params.name: top_p

params.description: Filter NaN and infinity during greedy and stochastic top-k selection. All-invalid logits still fail.
params.name: filter_nan_logits

params.description: Accepted for Python API compatibility; audio sampling does not consume this value. Compatibility-only, but must be finite and positive.
params.name: repetition_penalty

params.description: Torch sampling seed; omitted chooses a random seed.
params.name: seed
